verses.1: And I saw on the right side of the person sitting on the throne, a book written inside and outside it. It was sealed with seven seals.
verses.2: And we saw a powerful angel proclaiming with a loud voice: “Who is worthy to open this book and break its seals?”
verses.3: And no one could either in the heavens, or on the earth, or below the earth, uncover the book, nor can anyone see it.
verses.4: And I was very sad that no one was worthy of reading that book, or even of seeing it.
verses.5: And one of the elders said to me, “Do not cry.” For behold, the man from the tribe of Judah, David’s descendant, has succeeded in opening the book and unlocking its seven seals.
verses.6: And I saw in the middle of the throne, as well as among the four animals, an ox lying there, as if it had been slaughtered. It had seven horns and seven eyes; these are the seven spirits of God, who were sent out to rule over all the earth.
verses.7: And he also came and spoke from the right side of the throne.
verses.8: And when he received the book, those four animals and the twenty-four elders fell down before the bull. Each of them carried a lyre and golden trumpets filled with incense. These are the prayers of the saints.
verses.9: And they rejoice in hearing this news. They say that it’s right to take that book and open its seals. After all, you have taken it from the god in your own land, from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
verses.10: And you made them rulers over our God’s kingdom, and they will rule over the earth.
verses.11: And I saw, and I heard the voices of many angels around the throne, as well as those of the animals and the elders. Their numbers were countless, in thousands and millions.
verses.12: Saying with a loud voice: It is worthy to take the sacrificed lamb; it brings strength, wealth, wisdom, honor, respect, fame, and righteousness.
verses.13: And all that is built in the heavens and on the earth, as well as below the earth and on the seas, and everything that exists within them—I have heard them say: “To Him who sits on the throne, along with the bull, belongs glory, honor, and dominion for ever.”
verses.14: And they said, “The four animals.” Amen. And the elders also fell down and bowed in reverence.
